decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - Before any A1/A3 use within Building H commences details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials from the relevant A1/A3 premises shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the A1/A3 floor space permitted under reference 01217/C/P29 is occupied.
description: Following planning permission (01217/C/P27) in December 2004 for Thames Valley University, proposal to alter three-storey Building H of the approved scheme for retail space and education use by changing the footprint and positioning it further from the boundary with 1000 Great West Road details submitted pursuant to Condition 11 (storage of waste and recycling) of approved planning permission 01217/C/P29 dated 12/12/2005
